title.zh: 英伟达连跌六周,市值蒸发约US$1.6万亿,黄仁勋辞职后华尔街静待周二财报
title.en: Nvidia heads for a sixth straight weekly loss, shedding about US$1.6 trillion, as Wall Street awaits Tuesday's earnings

analysis.zh: 据CNBC,英伟达周四下跌4.3%,本周累计跌11%,有望连续第六周下跌,是2012年以来最长的连跌;这段期间股价已回落29%,约US$1.6万亿市值,并跌到苹果之后。黄仁勋因两起婚外情曝光辞职,CFO Colette Kress出任临时CEO。英伟达将于周二公布业绩,分析师预期营收为US$1,089亿(LSEG数据)。D.A. Davidson分析师将目标价从US$300降至US$200但维持买入评级,Oppenheimer则提醒短期基本面可能退居其次。就像一场重要考试前换了班主任,大家更关心的是接下来的成绩单。
analysis.en: According to CNBC, Nvidia fell 4.3% on Thursday and 11% for the week, putting it on track for a sixth straight weekly decline, its longest losing streak since 2012. The stock has lost 29% over the stretch, about US$1.6 trillion of market value, and slipped below Apple. Jensen Huang resigned after two extramarital affairs became public, and CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO. Nvidia reports on Tuesday, with analysts expecting revenue of US$108.9 billion (LSEG). D.A. Davidson cut its price target to US$200 from US$300 but kept a buy rating, while Oppenheimer said fundamentals may take a backseat near term. It is like a new class teacher arriving just before a big exam: everyone cares most about the coming report card.

dda.zh: 单一热门股连跌几周,提醒我们不要把整个计划押在一个主题上。定期定额(DDA)按固定节奏投入分散的信托基金,通常不需要为某家公司的财报日而调整节奏。
dda.en: A heavy multi-week slide in one popular stock is a reminder not to tie a whole plan to one theme. Regular (DDA) investing in diversified unit trusts at a steady pace generally does not require changing your rhythm around one company's earnings date.

prs.zh: 退休规划的时间跨度很长,短期的个股起伏通常不是决定因素。可以顺便了解自己的PRS基金科技股占比;每年最高RM3,000的PRS税务减免是持续供款的原因之一。
prs.en: Retirement planning has a long horizon, and short-term single-stock swings are generally not the deciding factor. It may be worth checking how much technology your PRS fund holds; the PRS tax relief of up to RM3,000 a year is one reason to keep contributing steadily.

lump.zh: 财报前后价格波动可能较大。若手上有一笔资金,可以考虑分批投入以分散时机风险,并检查是否已过度集中在AI相关主题,金额也要符合目标与风险承受度。
lump.en: Prices can swing widely around earnings. If you hold a lump sum, phasing in may spread timing risk; check whether you are already concentrated in AI-related themes, and keep the amount in line with your goals and risk tolerance.

bond.zh: 这则新闻主要是科技股与公司治理的故事,对马来西亚债券基金(MGS、企业债与伊斯兰债券)的直接影响有限。股市情绪波动时,债券基金一般扮演组合平衡者的角色。
bond.en: This is mainly a tech-stock and corporate-leadership story, so its direct effect on Malaysian bond funds (MGS, corporate bonds and sukuk) is limited. When equity sentiment swings, bond funds generally act as a portfolio balancer.

title.zh: 恒指收跌370点至23,637,科技指数大跌3%,油股逆势上涨
title.en: Hang Seng closes down 370 points at 23,637 as the tech index sinks 3% and oil stocks gain

analysis.zh: 据The Standard,恒生指数周五收跌370点(1.55%)至23,637点,全日成交额港币1,950亿元;恒生科技指数跌3%至3,813点,科技龙头跌幅介乎3%至7%。Z.AI跌10%、联想跌6.33%、阿里巴巴跌3.46%、腾讯跌3%,中芯国际仅跌0.45%。相反,中国石油股份涨2.8%、中国石化涨1.71%,因中东局势升温推高油价。上证综指跌0.59%至3,634点。就像一队人里领头的科技股掉了步,整个队伍的节奏就被拖慢。
analysis.en: According to The Standard, the Hang Seng Index closed down 370 points, or 1.55%, at 23,637 on Friday, with turnover of HK$195 billion; the Hang Seng Tech index fell 3% to 3,813 and tech majors dropped between 3% and 7%. Z.AI fell 10%, Lenovo 6.33%, Alibaba 3.46% and Tencent 3%, while SMIC slipped just 0.45%. PetroChina rose 2.8% and Sinopec 1.71% as Middle East tensions lifted oil prices. The Shanghai Composite fell 0.59% to 3,634. It is like the lead runners stumbling, slowing the whole pack.

dda.zh: 港股科技股波动较大,长期投资者可以通过分散于不同地区与行业的信托基金来平滑单一板块的起伏。定期定额(DDA)的好处是不必猜测短期的涨跌。
dda.en: Hong Kong tech stocks can be volatile; long-term investors may smooth out single-sector swings through unit trusts spread across regions and sectors. The benefit of regular (DDA) investing is not having to guess short-term moves.

prs.zh: 退休基金通常配置多个地区,大中华板块只是其中一部分。回顾PRS基金的地区分布,可以了解自己对中国与香港市场的敞口;每年最高RM3,000的PRS税务减免仍是持续供款的考虑之一。
prs.en: Retirement funds usually spread across regions, with Greater China only one part. Reviewing the regional mix of your PRS fund shows your exposure to China and Hong Kong; the PRS tax relief of up to RM3,000 a year remains one reason to contribute steadily.

lump.zh: 单日跌3%的板块提醒我们留意集中度。若考虑投入中国或香港相关基金,分批投入可分散时机风险,并确认符合自己的目标与风险承受度。
lump.en: A sector that falls 3% in one day is a reminder to watch concentration. If considering China or Hong Kong funds, phasing in may spread timing risk, and the choice should fit your goals and risk tolerance.

bond.zh: 港股行情对马来西亚债券基金(MGS、企业债与伊斯兰债券)的直接影响有限;不过油价与美元走势可能间接影响令吉与外资流向。债券基金在股市波动时一般起平衡作用。
bond.en: Hong Kong equity moves have limited direct effect on Malaysian bond funds (MGS, corporate bonds and sukuk), though oil and the US dollar may indirectly influence the ringgit and foreign flows. Bond funds generally balance a portfolio when stocks swing.

title.zh: 台股逆势收涨1.35%,加权指数报43,675点
title.en: Taiwan shares close up 1.35% at 43,675 even as Nvidia's CEO exits

analysis.zh: 据台湾中央社(Focus Taiwan),台湾加权指数周五收涨583.25点(1.35%)至43,675.12点,成交额新台币9,162.6亿元(约US$278亿)。这与港股同日下跌形成对比,也说明市场对黄仁勋辞职的反应并不一致。就像同一场雨,不同地方的人撑伞的反应各不相同。
analysis.en: According to Focus Taiwan (CNA), the Taiex closed up 583.25 points, or 1.35%, at 43,675.12 on Friday, on turnover of NT$916.26 billion (about US$27.79 billion). That contrasts with the same-day drop in Hong Kong and shows markets did not react to Jensen Huang's exit in one uniform way. It is like the same rain, with people in different places reacting differently.

dda.zh: 区域市场的表现常常不同步,这是分散投资的理由之一。定期定额(DDA)投入涵盖多个市场的信托基金,可能让单一市场的起落对整体影响较小。
dda.en: Regional markets often move out of step, which is one reason for diversification. Regular (DDA) investing in funds covering several markets may reduce the impact of any one market's swings.

prs.zh: 长期的退休规划不需要追逐每日的区域涨跌。可以定期检视PRS基金的地区与行业分布;每年最高RM3,000的PRS税务减免是持续供款的考虑之一。
prs.en: Long-term retirement planning does not need to chase daily regional moves. Reviewing the regional and sector mix of your PRS fund from time to time is useful; the PRS tax relief of up to RM3,000 a year is one reason to contribute steadily.

lump.zh: 单日上涨并不代表趋势。投入单笔资金时,分批投入可分散时机风险,同时留意是否过度集中于某一地区或半导体主题。
lump.en: One day's gain is not a trend. When investing a lump sum, phasing in may spread timing risk, and it helps to check for over-concentration in one region or the semiconductor theme.

bond.zh: 台股行情对马来西亚债券基金(MGS、企业债与伊斯兰债券)的直接影响有限;债券基金在股市分化时一般起组合平衡作用。
bond.en: Taiwan's stock moves have limited direct effect on Malaysian bond funds (MGS, corporate bonds and sukuk); bond funds generally balance a portfolio when equity markets diverge.

title.zh: 美国专家:黄仁勋辞职料不影响台积电与供应链
title.en: U.S. expert: Huang's exit unlikely to hurt TSMC or Nvidia's suppliers

analysis.zh: 据Focus Taiwan,美国创新基金会(Foundation for American Innovation)的Ryan Fedasiuk认为,英伟达是市值数万亿美元、拥有数以万计工程师的公司,黄仁勋辞职料不会影响台积电或其他供应商;物色正式继任者可能需要数周甚至数月,而由CFO领导的董事会是全球AI产业“稳定的支柱”。黄仁勋周四辞去CEO与董事职务,Colette Kress出任临时CEO。这就像一家餐厅换了主厨,供应商更关心的是订单会不会持续。
analysis.en: According to Focus Taiwan, Ryan Fedasiuk of the Foundation for American Innovation said Nvidia is a multitrillion-dollar company with tens of thousands of engineers, so Jensen Huang's departure is unlikely to affect TSMC or other suppliers; finding a permanent successor could take weeks or months, and he called the CFO-led board a stable backbone of the global AI industry. Huang stepped down as CEO and from the board on Thursday, with Colette Kress as interim CEO. It is like a restaurant changing head chef: suppliers mainly care whether the orders keep coming.

dda.zh: 这类专家观点只是参考,供应链的实际影响要看之后的财报与订单。长期投资者可以通过分散的信托基金投资科技产业链,定期定额(DDA)的节奏则不必因新闻而频繁改动。
dda.en: Expert views like this are only a reference; the real supply-chain impact will show in coming earnings and orders. Long-term investors can gain tech supply-chain exposure through diversified unit trusts, and a regular (DDA) rhythm generally need not change with each headline.

prs.zh: 退休规划看的是长期目标。若PRS基金含有亚洲科技股,可了解其占比与分散程度;每年最高RM3,000的PRS税务减免是持续供款的考虑之一。
prs.en: Retirement planning looks to long-term goals. If your PRS fund holds Asian tech, it may be worth checking its weight and diversification; the PRS tax relief of up to RM3,000 a year is one reason to contribute steadily.

lump.zh: 半导体与AI主题的消息面较密集,单笔资金若集中投入同一主题,波动可能被放大。分批投入可分散时机风险,并确认符合目标与风险承受度。
lump.en: News flow on semiconductors and AI is dense, and a lump sum concentrated in one theme may see amplified swings. Phasing in may spread timing risk, and the amount should fit your goals and risk tolerance.

bond.zh: 这则新闻对马来西亚债券基金(MGS、企业债与伊斯兰债券)的直接影响有限,主要影响科技股情绪。债券基金在股市情绪波动时一般扮演平衡者。
bond.en: This story has limited direct effect on Malaysian bond funds (MGS, corporate bonds and sukuk) and mainly touches tech sentiment. Bond funds generally act as a balancer when equity sentiment swings.

title.zh: 特朗普称不再需要伊朗协议,布伦特油价徘徊US$95.7,本周料小跌2.4%
title.en: Trump says no Iran deal needed; Brent hovers near US$95.7 and is set for a 2.4% weekly loss

analysis.zh: 据Investing.com,特朗普周四表示美国不再需要与伊朗达成协议,并让副总统万斯转向国内事务,令结束冲突的希望降温。截至格林威治时间04:36,布伦特原油报US$95.71(-0.1%),WTI报US$88.38(-0.4%);布伦特本周料跌2.4%,上周曾暴跌16%,但今年以来仍高出近60%。美国对伊朗石油的海上封锁与制裁仍在,10月商船遇袭36起,为冲突以来最高。就像水龙头时开时关,价格自然忽高忽低。
analysis.en: According to Investing.com, President Trump said on Thursday that Washington no longer needs a deal with Iran and redirected VP JD Vance to domestic priorities, dimming hopes of ending the conflict. As of 04:36 GMT, Brent was US$95.71 (-0.1%) and WTI US$88.38 (-0.4%); Brent is heading for a 2.4% weekly decline after a 16% plunge the previous week, but is still nearly 60% higher year to date. The US blockade of Iranian oil shipments and sanctions remain, and Verisk Maplecroft counted 36 confirmed attacks on commercial vessels in October, the most since the conflict began. It is like a tap turning on and off, so prices swing up and down.

dda.zh: 油价大起大落会影响通胀预期与市场情绪。定期定额(DDA)按固定节奏投入,可能让你不必猜测油价与地缘消息的走向。
dda.en: Large oil swings can affect inflation expectations and market sentiment. Regular (DDA) investing at a steady pace may spare you from guessing the path of oil and geopolitical news.

prs.zh: 油价影响生活成本,长期来看也影响退休所需的开销。退休规划可以把通胀纳入考虑;每年最高RM3,000的PRS税务减免是持续供款的考虑之一。
prs.en: Oil affects the cost of living and, over time, the spending retirement needs to cover, so inflation is worth building into retirement plans; the PRS tax relief of up to RM3,000 a year is one reason to contribute steadily.

lump.zh: 能源与地缘消息容易引发短期波动。单笔资金可考虑分批投入以分散时机风险,并检查是否过度集中在能源或周期性板块,金额须符合目标与风险承受度。
lump.en: Energy and geopolitical news can trigger short-term swings. A lump sum may be phased in to spread timing risk, with a check for concentration in energy or cyclical sectors and an amount that fits your goals and risk tolerance.

bond.zh: 油价上升可能推高通胀预期,进而影响利率走向与国家银行(BNM)的政策考量;油价也牵涉令吉与外资流向,可能影响马来西亚政府债券(MGS)与企业债、伊斯兰债券的价格。债券基金在组合中一般起平衡作用。
bond.en: Higher oil may lift inflation expectations and in turn affect interest-rate paths and Bank Negara's policy considerations; oil also ties into the ringgit and foreign flows, which may influence prices of MGS, corporate bonds and sukuk. Bond funds generally act as a portfolio balancer.

title.zh: 欧洲股市从纪录高位回落,英伟达风波令AI前景添不确定
title.en: European shares retreat from record highs as Nvidia upheaval clouds the AI outlook

analysis.zh: 据路透社(Investing.com转载),泛欧STOXX 600周五早段下跌0.2%至662.64点,前一天曾创纪录高位,本周仍升逾2%,为6月以来最强的单周表现。黄仁勋突然辞职令AI交易前景添变数;科技板块跌0.6%,Siltronic与Aixtron各跌逾1%。文章指出欧洲的AI相关股票占比较美国低,是欧股创高的原因之一;高盛将12个月目标上调至700点。就像同一场球赛,守门员出事时,前锋少的球队受的影响相对较小。
analysis.en: According to Reuters (via Investing.com), the pan-European STOXX 600 was down 0.2% at 662.64 in early Friday trading after hitting a record high the previous session, still up more than 2% for the week, its best week since June. Jensen Huang's abrupt resignation clouded the AI trade; the tech sector fell 0.6%, with Siltronic and Aixtron each down more than 1%. The article says Europe has less exposure to AI-linked stocks than the US, one reason it reached records; Goldman Sachs raised its 12-month target to 700. It is like a match where one team's goalkeeper is in trouble: the side with fewer attackers on the line feels it less.

dda.zh: 全球不同市场的涨跌节奏不一,这正是分散投资的理由。定期定额(DDA)投入覆盖不同地区的信托基金,可能让单一主题的波动影响较小。
dda.en: Global markets do not move in step, which is the case for diversification. Regular (DDA) investing in unit trusts covering different regions may reduce the effect of any single theme's swings.

prs.zh: 退休规划强调长期与分散。可以回顾PRS基金的地区分布,了解对美国科技与其他地区的敞口;每年最高RM3,000的PRS税务减免是持续供款的考虑之一。
prs.en: Retirement planning stresses long horizons and diversification. Reviewing the regional mix of your PRS fund shows your exposure to US tech versus other regions; the PRS tax relief of up to RM3,000 a year is one reason to contribute steadily.

lump.zh: 市场处于高位时,单笔投入的时机风险更值得留意。分批投入可分散时机风险,同时检查组合是否过度集中于某一地区或主题。
lump.en: When markets sit near highs, timing risk on a lump sum deserves more attention. Phasing in may spread that risk, and it helps to check the portfolio for concentration in one region or theme.

bond.zh: 欧洲股市的波动对马来西亚债券基金(MGS、企业债与伊斯兰债券)的直接影响有限。股市风险情绪转变时,债券基金一般扮演组合平衡者。
bond.en: European equity moves have limited direct effect on Malaysian bond funds (MGS, corporate bonds and sukuk). When risk sentiment shifts, bond funds generally act as a portfolio balancer.
